scope: Within the accepted F02 risk fleet, compare one versus two P-MAINT workers for PM and system LRU replacement; P-CREW remains one and may still queue.

source.boundary: One worker in the accepted parent causes an explicit P-MAINT wait between simultaneous first-day PM subtask requests and also serves later aircraft LRU replacement. Second-day PM tasks occur sequentially without a simultaneous worker request. Raising allocation to two tests the first-day worker conflict only; it does not remove preparation-crew contention or establish all conflict-free support.

pre_run_hypotheses: The sole authored change is ResourceAllocation(P-MAINT,BASE-01).RQTY 1→2. The new input roundtrips exactly. Native import, export, calculation and report complete under session-0 SSH, host mutex and preserved GUI; converter diagnostic set is zero errors and only reviewed warning #108.

The accepted parent has simultaneous first-day CAL24 PM subtask requests at hour 28.5 and one P-MAINT worker; the second waits to hour 29.5. With two workers, those two first-day PM subtasks should overlap rather than queue on P-MAINT. Confirm request/grant/release timestamps and distinguish P-CREW preparation waits. Treat second-day PM timing as observed behavior, not a preset capacity effect.

Reconcile all four mission opportunities, aircraft identities, risk failure/abort/cancellation, physical depot LRU/SRU and two-way transport ledgers against the parent; changed random draws or outcomes must be attributed from native events rather than assumed equal.

Reconcile each of 120 half-hour System, Stock and Resource result rows with the event timelines, terminal aircraft readiness, outstanding worker requests, stock backorders, in-repair and in-transit identities. ResourceResults.NR rises from two to three and worker utilization/queue rows reflect actual booking.

Acceptance requires an observed one-worker P-MAINT wait in the parent and its absence for the same competing PM window in the new arm, plus complete paired raw seals, exact source/diff, author and independent read-only replay. If the allocation does not remove the targeted contention or any other gate fails, preserve this version as an excluded diagnostic and revise under a fresh version.
limits: One seed, one risk profile, two aircraft, one base/depot route and 60 hours. Only P-MAINT capacity changes; P-CREW remains shared and may queue.

The case does not establish generic conflict resolution, all-resource no-conflict behavior, priority policies, stochastic distributions, larger fleets, GUI visual behavior or cross-engine equivalence.
